mainTopicBrief: 本单元 Reading 用细腻笔触写一家蒙尘旧书店与逝去的时光。仿写训练精选课文金句，收录课堂‘排比 + 独立主格、表语前置倒装、shatter/mourn 情感动词’的同学优秀仿写。

items.focusType: 排比铺陈 + 独立主格收尾
items.focus: 三个短句排比铺陈场景，再用 ‘each/all + V-ing/V-ed’ 的独立主格收束，情景交融。
items.original: The bookshelves lay buried in dust, the wooden sign was worn and the once warm light dimmed, each mourning its former grace.
items.cn: 书架蒙尘，木招牌磨损斑驳，曾经温暖的灯光也黯淡了——每一样都在哀悼自己昔日的风采。

models.en: The unexpected outcome shattered the whole team, their once burning determination dimming in their eyes.
The old house stood silent, the windows cracked, the garden overgrown, each corner whispering of the family that had left.

items.tip: 独立主格结构 = 名词 + 分词(each mourning / their determination dimming)，逻辑主语与主句不同，最适合‘以景结情’。

items.focusType: 表语/方位前置的完全倒装
items.focus: 把 Lying before me / Scattered across... 这类分词表语提到句首，谓语提前，画面扑面而来。
items.original: As the fragrance of old wooden furniture drifted into my nose, I found myself mourning my lost childhood.
items.cn: 旧木家具的香气飘进鼻腔，我发觉自己正在哀悼逝去的童年。

models.en: Lying before me were the old yet meaningful objects, all laden with the emotional bond I shared with the bookshop.
Scattered across my desk were the yellowed letters, each carrying a fragment of a summer long gone.

items.tip: find oneself doing 表‘不知不觉地……’，很适合写情绪的悄然来袭。

items.focusType: shatter / mourn 等情感动词升格
items.focus: 用 shatter(击碎)、mourn(哀悼)、hover(盘旋)等富有情感重量的动词，替换 break/miss，一下子拉高感染力。
items.original: A cloud of hopelessness hovered over him, shattering the last thread of hope in his mind.
items.cn: 一团绝望的阴云悬在他头顶，击碎了他心中最后一线希望。

models.en: A wave of relief washed over her, melting the fear that had frozen her heart all night.
His harsh words shattered the fragile confidence she had spent years rebuilding.

items.tip: ‘a cloud of / a wave of + 抽象情感’是把情绪具象化的好模板；后接现在分词作结果状语。
